More info Transportation in a shuttle bus Tasting fees to four wineries on the Sunnyslope Wine Trail Unlimited water Packaged snacks Experienced wine tour guide Minimum group of 10—up to 14 people What to bring If you ordered an individual charcuterie tray through us, we will have those ready for you. If not please feel free to bring a lunch to enjoy at one of the wineries. We highly encourage our guests to eat during the 6.5 Hours • Tastings at 4 Wineries • Shuttle Transportation • Minimum Group of 10
